integrity: Complete self-contained proof plus an exact-arithmetic finite-field reproduction script; those finite computations are not proofs of infinite asymptotics.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-field large-matrix asymptotics; no exact total-variation profile at bounded offsets or simultaneous large-field theorem. The finite-dimensional Fourier eigenline identity was previously known and is explicitly credited. An unindexed identical mixing theorem is not excluded. Independent validation not performed.
title: A one-matrix-scale mixing cutoff and an explicit chi-square window for nilpotent rank-one addition
